notes.title: 🎉 Full Void's 1-Year Anniversary Celebration on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that Full Void is celebrating its 1-year anniversary on Steam! Released on July 18, 2023, this year has been an incredible journey, and we are deeply grateful for the support and love from our amazing community.

Full Void is a 2D Cinematic Puzzle Platformer that takes players on an emotional and thrilling adventure through a dystopian future. As a young teenager, you must navigate a city controlled by a rogue AI, using your wits and skills to overcome various challenges and uncover the story of your protagonist's quest to save humanity. Entirely handrawn and hand animated in pixel art.

[b]Special Anniversary Sale![/b]
To celebrate this milestone, we are offering a 50% discount on Full Void until July 22nd. Don’t miss this chance to dive into this award-winning and critically acclaimed adventure at half the price!

[b]Join the Celebration[/b]
We want to thank each and every one of you for your continued support and for making Full Void a part of your gaming library. To join the celebration, share your favorite moments, fan art, and reviews on our Steam Community Hub, and follow us on Twitter, Instagram and TikTok for more updates!

Thank you for an incredible year, and we can’t wait to bring you more exciting adventures in the future!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Full Void wins Debug Indie Games Awards in Subscribers' Choice category!
notes.content:
Dear OutOfTheBit Community,

We are thrilled to announce that Full Void, has won the Debug Indie Games Award in the Subscribers' Choice category! This prestigious accolade was presented to us last Friday during the successful inaugural edition of DebugU in Nottingham, and we couldn't be more proud.

[previewyoutube=-RomSWbAPF0;full][/previewyoutube]

This award represents not just a significant milestone for Full Void but also a testament to the passion and hard work of our team here at OutOfTheBit. The Subscribers' Choice category is particularly special to us as it reflects the voices of the gaming community impersonate by the readers of the amazing magazine that debug is. Your support and enthusiasm for Full Void have truly made this achievement possible.

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who voted for Full Void. Your belief in our vision and your continued support inspire us every day. This award motivates us to keep pushing the boundaries of indie gaming, pixel art and frame-by-frame animation, creating experiences that are not only innovative and engaging but also deeply resonant.

As we celebrate this achievement, we're also reminded of the journey that brought us here. From the initial concept to the challenges we faced during the development as a small indie team. This award is a milestone in Full Void's journey, but it's also just the beginning for the OutOfTheBit Team. We have many more stories to tell, puzzles to solve, and worlds to explore together.

For those who haven't yet experienced Full Void, we warmly invite you to join us on this award-winning (!) adventure. Discover the mysteries, solve the puzzles, and immerse yourself in the captivating story that has won the hearts of gamers and critics alike.

Thank you once again to the amazing Debug Team, our incredible community, and everyone who has been a part of this journey. Here's to many more achievements, adventures, and unforgettable moments in the world of indie gaming.

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: 🚀 Full Void physical release on Evercade – A Dream Come True! 🕹️🎉
notes.content:
Dear Full Void Community,

We are absolutely thrilled to share some incredible news with all of you! Full Void is making its way to the Evercade!

If you're new to Evercade, this is a retro gaming system that uses physical cartridges to play games! They officially licence retro and new games and put them in cartridges to run on the Evercade VS Home Console and the Evercade handhelds. Each cartridge contains a collection of games that could be either of the same developer or from a gaming system or the arcade. You get your copy in a clamshell box complete with a manual. Very retro style!

That, until now. In fact, Full Void is going to be their first single game release!

For us, the journey to bring Full Void to Evercade has been nothing short of a dream come true. As game developers, there's an indescribable magic in holding a physical copy of our creation in our hands. And the Evercade, with its delightful retro charm, feels like the perfect match for Full Void.

We've poured our hearts into this game, carefully crafting a blend of nostalgia and innovation that we hope resonates with both our audiences. The overlap between Evercade enthusiasts and those who appreciate the depth we've put into Full Void is truly beautiful.

We want to thank Blaze for the opportunity and we are counting the days that separates us to the release in October.

In the meantime, Full Void's cartidges, both the regular and the special edition, are available to pre-order!
YES! You read it right! There's going to be a [b]SPECIAL EDITION[/b] where you'll find a delightful artbook and a comic that our artists made especially for the occasion to tell you more about the backstory of Full Void). 

If you enjoyed playing Full Void and you want to own a physical copy, to hold in your hands and collect, this is for you. But be mindfull that copies are selling fast! Here's is a link to Amazon. Until stock lasts.
[url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/Evercade-Full-Void-Special-Edition/dp/B0CDCLSQ95]Pre-order your copy of Full Void - Special Edition[/url]

And if you've missed out on the announcement, here's your chance to catch up!

[previewyoutube=IndRPsEgpgI;full][/previewyoutube]


Until next time,

The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Last Chance to Try Full Void Demo: Leaving Steam This Monday!
notes.content:
Hello Full Void Community!

We're nearing the countdown to release, but before that, we've got some important news for you. This is the final weekend to journey into our dystopian future with the Full Void demo. The demo vanishes from Steam on Monday, so make sure you dive in and experience the thrill of the chase, the challenge of the puzzles, and the stark beauty of our hand-drawn pixel art world.

notes.title: Release is one month away
notes.content:
Dear players,

If only we could convey with words the amount of excitment pulsing through our office! 
After about two years of development, Full Void release date is getting close. On the 18th of July we will finally be able to share the whole game with you and we're eager to hear what you think.

Your feedback from the demo and the beta has been invaluable. We've put everything into making Full Void a memorable experience and are now in the process of perfecting the final details, including some new cut scene animations that we added during the beta and some audio that will add substantially to the experience.

As we approach the release date, we're also planning some special events to show our appreciation for your support. This will include a live Q&A with our developers and exclusive reveals. Stay tuned for more details on these events, and make sure you're following us on our social channels to get the latest updates.

Your enthusiasm and support for Full Void have been a constant source of motivation for us. We're excited for you to experience the game on July 18th.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us.

Best,
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Full Void Launch Date Confirmed & Closed Beta Testing Opportunity
notes.content:
Dear players and community members!

We're thrilled to announce that Full Void will be officially released on the Steam platform on the 18th of July! 

To ensure we offer you the best gaming experience possible, we're inviting gamers to participate in a closed beta testing phase in mid-June. This will be an opportunity for you to have a first look at the game and help us gather valuable feedback before the official release.

If you're interested in participating in the beta testing, please email us at info@outofthebit.com expressing your interest. Of those who will write to us we will randomly pick a limited number of people to take part in the beta.
Please note that participants will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to ensure the content of the beta remains confidential.

Stay tuned for more updates, including the launch date on consoles, which we'll be announcing soon.

Thank you for your continued support and excitement for Full Void. We can't wait for you to dive into our dystopian world this July!

Best,

The OutOfTheBit Team

*Release date amended due to clashing events.

notes.title: Final Polish and Additional Content!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players and community members!

As you know we've been hard at work on Full Void, refining the gameplay and adding a layer of polish to make it an unforgettable experience for all of you.
However, during this process, we decided to add a bit more vital content to the game.
This means more features, more levels, and more fun for you to enjoy. We genuinely believe that this extra content will significantly enhance your gaming experience and make it worth the wait.
That being said, due to the addition of this new content, the polishing process has taken a bit longer than we initially anticipated. We understand that you've all been eagerly waiting for the game's release, and we appreciate the support you've given us so far.
We want to assure you that our team is working full-time to finalise the game and deliver it to you in the best possible condition. Our top priority is to provide you with an immersive, enjoyable, and complete experience that you'll cherish for a long time.

Thank you for your understanding, patience, and continuous support. We're confident that you'll love what we have in store for you, and we can't wait for you to dive into the world we've created!

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep an eye on our Steam page for the upcoming release date announcement!

Best regards,
The OutOfTheBit Team
